text: The solver's output shows that a spacecraft could intercept the interstellar object 2I/Borisov in a patched-conic, two-body trajectory with no n-body integration or non-gravitational forces. The mission would depart Earth on March 13, 2030, with a departure C3 of 1727.89 km²/s² and a hyperbolic excess speed of 41.56787 km/s relative to Earth. The flight time to reach 2I/Borisov would be 7305 days, or approximately 20 years, arriving on March 13, 2050. At arrival, the spacecraft would have a relative velocity of 16.89188 km/s with respect to the object, which is close to the asymptotic value of 16.93682 km/s reported in the source paper.
verification_status: computed with the same method; no published intercept study exists to validate against
